description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'CodeValuesApiResource' for managing code values within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting code values, with security and serialization handling.

classes.name: CodeValuesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing code values, including endpoints for CRUD operations, secured with user permissions, and utilizing serialization and command pattern services.

methods.name: retrieveAllCodeValues
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all code values for a specific code ID.

methods.name: retrieveCodeValue
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific code value by ID.

methods.name: createCodeValue
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new code value under a specific code ID.

methods.name: updateCodeValue
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing code value.

methods.name: deleteCodeValue
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a code value.
